query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dndSms = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnd_sms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dndEmail = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnd_email,
  SUM(CASE WHEN reactivatedFromMigration = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reactivated
FROM leads 
WHERE DATEDIFF(NOW(), createdAt) >= 365
  AND preferredChannel = 'Email'
  AND (opportunityStatus IS NULL OR opportunityStatus NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'abandoned'))
  AND humanTakeover = 0
  AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '';
